prompt:
A top-down vertical POV shot looking straight down at a Berlin sidewalk
on an overcast morning. On the LEFT side of the frame, a bicycle lane
painted a faded dusty brick red, muted and desaturated, featuring one
white painted bicycle icon; that red lane is completely clear, carrying
nothing but its painted icon. Running vertically down the frame, a sharp
straight boundary line. On the RIGHT side of the frame, filling two
thirds of the width, clean grey concrete pavement slabs. Positioned
squarely on those grey concrete slabs, a man's two white leather low-top
sneakers with white laces stand completely still, side by side, both
soles flat on the grey. Above the sneakers his own legs enter the frame
in foreshortened subjective POV perspective, the beige cotton chino
trousers running from the knee down to the ankle and filling the bottom
of the picture. Flat overcast daylight, realistic pavement texture,
crisp focus.
